name: Ikiru Sushi
notes: Own domain ikirusushisd.com is now hijacked -- redirects to curiouspatch.com, a generic SEO content-farm article about San Diego sushi in general (not this restaurant), with an obfuscated tracking token in the URL. Left without clicking further. DoorDash listing for 'Ikiru Japanese' confirmed not active/orderable. Grubhub link returned no content. allmenus.com has a full, well-structured ~150-item menu (nigiri, rolls, ramen, katsu, donburi, curry, udon, yakisoba, combos) but carries no date and prices read low for 2026 (cut rolls $4-6, seared/baked rolls $9-12) -- consistent with staleness. restaurantguru's menu page shows 'added by users 26 days ago' but is image-only with no readable prices in text, so it could not serve as the required independent cross-check. Per the Curbside Cafe precedent (hijacked domain + no independent corroboration), recording the allmenus dishes uncorroborated would risk publishing a stale/wrong menu, so this is a genuine not-found rather than blocked -- no better source exists.

notes: Restaurant's own site (phokitchenusa.com) lists only its Mira Mesa location; the Napa St address in the worklist is a SEPARATE store with its own subdomain, napa.phokitchenusa.com (avoided the wrong-branch trap -- the Mira Mesa order.online storefront was checked first and correctly discarded once the address mismatch was noticed). The Napa St site's own ordering UI shows 'Online Ordering Currently Closed' and is powered by 'Smart Online Order' (Clover). Reading /wp-json/moo-clover/v1/categories then /categories/{uuid}/items directly (Clover REST API) returned the full priced menu regardless of the closed-ordering-window UI gate. All 10 real categories reached: Drink, Appetizers, Pho, Com/Bun (Rice), Com/Bun (Vermicelli), Egg Noodles, Vegetarian, Bread, Kid Meals, Misc. 'Gift Cards' and 'Best Sellers' categories skipped (not real menu sections). Prices cross-check exactly against the Mira Mesa order.online listing for shared items (e.g. P1 Pho Filet $13.50 at both), so no markup detected.

name: Robertacos
notes: WRONG-BUSINESS TRAP CHECKED AND AVOIDED: the worklist website (runinos.com) pointed at a Roberto's Taco Shop location in Chula Vista, a different address from this restaurant's 492 W San Ysidro Blvd. Checked BOTH San Diego Roberto's Taco Shop chain sites (robertostacoshopsd.com/locations and robertostacoshop.com/locations) in full -- neither lists a San Ysidro / 492 W San Ysidro Blvd location, confirming 'Robertacos' (492 W San Ysidro Blvd, San Ysidro, CA 92173) is an independent, unaffiliated business sharing a similar name, not a branch of either chain. Did not borrow either chain's menu. The restaurant itself has no findable website or ordering platform (SinglePlatform's menu is explicitly disabled/removed; DoorDash does not list delivery for this address). allmenus.com carries a full, well-structured menu, but every price is implausibly low for 2026 (tacos $2.50, sodas $1.48, breakfast burritos $4.50-4.99) -- consistent with a menu captured many years ago and never refreshed, not a current price list. No dated photo or second source was found to confirm or date it. Recorded not-found: the restaurant plainly still trades (recent 2026 Yelp activity), but no current priced source exists.

name: Star Club
notes: Confirmed this is Star Bar at 423 E St, Gaslamp (address matches worklist exactly; 'Star Club' appears to be an OSM name variant of the same bar). A dive bar with no kitchen -- its own site says food is delivered from neighboring Coastal Cantina or Tony's Pizza rather than served in-house. No itemized drink menu exists anywhere checked: the site's Specials/Events page, a Toast business listing (present but with no online-ordering menu configured -- just a directory entry with 'Closed' hours shown, i.e. never opened for online orders), and search results only surface vague prose ranges ('beer $3-7', 'wells $4', '$3 Busch pints') rather than a priced list of named drinks. This is a genuine case of a venue that does not publish an itemized menu, not a source that is temporarily unreachable.

THE HOMEPAGE'S 'ADULT BEVERAGES' SECTION WAS NOT FOUND on the Toast ordering site -- likely an in-person-only offering not sold through online ordering, so it is a known gap rather than a missed category.

name: Rooftop Bar
notes: This is The Rooftop Bar at the Mission Pacific Hotel (JdV by Hyatt), Oceanside -- matches the worklist address in substance (Mission Pacific Hotel, Oceanside) though the site itself never prints a bare street address; corroborated via search as 201 N Myers St. The restaurant's OWN site has an extensive, fully itemized menu (cocktails, espresso martinis, non-alcoholic cocktails, canned/draught beer, snacks, chilled seafood, small plates, spreads, grill/plancha entrees, desserts, a late-night menu) across every section a diner would expect -- but NOT ONE dish or drink carries a price anywhere on the site. Checked Tripadvisor and general search for a priced version (menu photos, a third-party listing) and found none; OpenTable is reservations-only. This is a deliberate fine-dining/hotel-bar choice not to publish prices (the Marisi pattern), so it is recorded not-found rather than blocked.
